title: Hearth of the Veil
shortDescription: Silver curtains keep half the room in honest shadow.
longDescription:
The Hearth of the Veil is quieter than its neighbours. Pale curtains take the light and give it back in pieces, like moonlight through thin ice. A tall dark mirror stands where a first-year will want to look too long. The floor is worn in a path that does not go straight. The air smells of cold stone, silver polish, and a little crushed lavender.
Mentor Mist does not fill the silence. She uses it.
A straw hearth dummy stands where a lesson can be finished without guessing.

fixtures.name: Mentor Mist
fixtures.lookDescription: A pale ermine in a silver-grey cloak, one eye kept in shadow. Try talk mist.
fixtures.examineDescription: Mist's fur is almost white. The cloak drinks sound. She watches the end of a sentence, not the start of it.
fixtures.dialogue: Mist stands where the curtain light falls in strips and does not step out of it. "The Veil is work done without announcing it first. Students find that harder than fire." She indicates the straw dummy in the corner. "Talk mist when you are ready."

welcome.text: "Lavender. Cold stone. A mirror that is only a mirror until you waste time in it. Look around this hearth. Then attack the hearth dummy in here, mine and not the one Flint keeps out in his orchard, unless you are still learning the spark on his. Come back and talk to me. I will open this School's leaf and ink its stem."

craft.text: "The Field Primer is your book. I open this School's leaf and ink the stem after you look around this hearth, defeat the dummy, and talk to me. Later the Primer holds ink. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name. Quiet work is still work. Do not skip the dummy because the room is dim."

go.text: "Look around this hearth. Defeat the dummy. I will be here in the quiet. The silence is not empty. Neither am I."

lessons-done.text: "The stem is inked. Cast shade at the hearth dummy for the second lesson. After that, the Primer holds one ink. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name."

third-lesson.text: "The curtain is open. You will notice that. Talk to Headmaster Alder in the High Study, up from the Great Hall. If he has you on the Clock Tower stair, finish it first. When he says the grounds will teach the rest, come back and talk to me."

third-done.text: "This hearth is finished with you. Each lesson off the grounds leaves one ink in the Primer, and I sign the page whether I am at your shoulder or not." She lets that stand. "Keeper Holm kept a stair lit so first-years would not walk it in the dark. That is the only reason I will tell you to eat something warm before you walk a cold road."

fixtures.name: Dark Mirror
fixtures.examineDescription: The glass does not flatter. It shows the room behind you more clearly than the face in front. A slate says: 'Name what moved.'
